summary: In 300 patients with 152 deaths the reconstructed mean-probe NRRS gave HR 1.456 per SD (95% CI 1.239-1.711; p=5.17e-06) and high-versus-low HR 1.529 (95% CI 1.109-2.107; log-rank p=0.00906); C-index 0.596.
limitation: GSE62254 participated in anchor feature screening; the median cutoff and probe rule are reconstructed; association is not independent validation or individual-patient deployment.

summary: All eight genes mapped to 19 unambiguous probes. Mean-probe and highest-variance-probe scores had Spearman rho 0.972 and 95.3% group agreement, so 14 of 300 patient labels changed while both survival directions remained adverse.
limitation: Only two defensible outcome-blind probe rules were compared; the anchor's actual rule is unknown.
